context_for_next_testing_agent: Two features fully tested: 1) Bulk Enrollment with Magic Links - org admins and teachers can bulk enroll users via email list, magic links are generated with 72-hour expiry, pending invitations can be viewed and resent. 2) Teacher File Upload - teachers can upload files (PDF, DOCX, MP4, images up to 100MB) directly to courses. Files are stored in /app/course_uploads/{course_id}/ and served via /api/content/files/{course_id}/{filename}. AcceptInvitePage error handling was fixed to show user-friendly messages instead of technical errors.
